title: "Area 51, the Ranch" – Groom Lake base with mountains (Chapter 2, p. 57)
description: High-contrast black-and-white photograph of a small cluster of buildings and hangars, including a tower, on a flat dry lakebed plain with a mountain range in the background. Captioned "Area 51, the Ranch." The text explains that Kelly Johnson named the facility Paradise Ranch, shortened to the Ranch, and that the base was ready by July 1955.
